Ava M: Heads upAP-398 and AP-402 action items are overdue in the tracker. Can owners confirm status?
Diego H: AP-398 (metrics alert tuning) is blocked by a missing dashboard query from Observability. I filed OBS-77. ETA depends on that.
Nora S: AP-402 (session-store failover test) - I started the playbook but didn't get to run the chaos tests last week. Will schedule for Wed.
Ava M: We need hard ETAs. If anyone cannot complete by Friday EOD assign an alternate owner so we don't carry this into next sprint.
Ethan P: I can take over AP-398 if OBS team doesn't unblock by Thursday noon. Diego, please link the exact query snippet here.
Diego H: Query is in OBS ticket: https://tickets.redwood.ai/OBS-77, snippet attached in the ticket. Also adding quick block note: "needs read access to infra metrics schema".
remind-bot: Reminder: AP-398/AP-402 overdue actions. Escalation in 48h unless updated.
Ava M: Also flagging a pattern: two of the last four incidents had incomplete validation steps before rollout. Suggest a mandatory "pre-rollout validation" action added to all pm follow-ups.
SRE Lead: Agree. Please add a standard checklist entry. Proposed minimal checklist:
```
- run integration smoke suite
- verify alert thresholds for impacted services
- validate canary on prod-like dataset
- confirm KV store failover behavior
```
Nora S: I'll add the checklist to the postmortem template and update AP-402.
Ethan P: I accepted AP-398 in the tracker and set ETA to 2026-05-07 12:00 PT.
Diego H: OBS-77 got read access approved, Diego -> Ethan: I just added the query to the ticket and pinged observability.
Ava M: Good. If anything slips past Friday I'll reassign to the on-call owner and file a follow-up retro card.
remind-bot: Closure verification scheduled for 2026-05-08 17:00 PT.
Nora S: Chaos tests scheduled for Wed 09:00 PT, will post results to the tracker by 13:00 PT.
Ava M: Thanks team. Marking this thread for follow-up at closure verification time.
SRE Lead: Logging for recurring pattern noted; will bring to reliability sync and propose enforcement of pre-rollout checklist in CI gating.
